The '''Mark V Temple Guardian Droid''' was a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] model used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to guard the [[Dark Temple]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="TOR" />
